repo.note: directus/api, 837 non-test src files. Chosen by `npm run screen` for long runtime loops: a 157-file runtime cycle group in which 89 files (57%) have no loop back to themselves shorter than 6 files, longest 13 (see candidates-config/README.md). Selected on purpose - results here are conditional on long loops and must be reported that way. Compiler settings come from the npm package @directus/tsconfig node22 v4.0.0, which sets verbatimModuleSyntax. Clone sparsely (api/, packages/, root *.json) and copy candidates-config/directus-api.tsconfig.rie.json to api/tsconfig.rie.json.
